The video opens with a view of several men standing together, all wearing matching red jerseys with "Los Angeles LXA" emblazoned on the front. One of the men, bald and holding a bowling ball, is the focal point; he holds the ball against his chest, looking down at it before beginning his approach to bowl. As he starts his motion, the camera angle switches to show the bowling lane and pins. As the bowler releases the ball, graphics appear, tracking its speed (19.1 MPH) and rotation (496 RPM) as it heads towards the pins. The graphic also shows where the ball was released on the lane. The ball hits the pins but leaves the 7-pin standing. After the ball hits, the bowler is seen smiling with his teammates in the background. At the bottom of the screen, text reads: "Series History: L.A. X leads 1-0" and "#4 L.A. X vs #8 NYC Kingpins." Below this, it states: "Last Meeting: 2014 SF (L.A. X won 5-1)." This information indicates that it is a competition between the Los Angeles LXA team and the NYC Kingpins. The setting appears to be a professional bowling alley, with spectators visible in the background. Christmas decorations, including a Santa hat, are spotted among the crowd.

The video opens with a shot of a bowler, Darren Tang, wearing a blue and black jersey, staring ahead with a serious expression. Behind him are a few other men in similar jerseys, standing and watching. On the left of the screen, text appears stating "PBA LEAGUE" and listing rules for a "Baker Team Match - Race to 2 Points": "WINNER OF GAME 1 EARNS 1 POINT," "WINNER OF GAME 2 EARNS 1 POINT," and "IF TIED AFTER 2 GAMES, WINNER OF ROLL-OFF EARNS 1 POINT," meaning the team must win two games to win the match, or the team with the most points wins, with a roll-off to break ties. The camera then follows Darren Tang as he walks to the lane and throws the bowling ball. Text and graphics appear on the screen to show the path of the bowling ball as it heads down the lane and hits the pins for a strike. The setting is a bowling alley, with multiple lanes visible.

The shot then changes to a man wearing a red jersey adorned with the logos of his team "Los Angeles X" holding the ball ready to bowl, he is in a pose for the shot. The man raises his arms in celebration, surrounded by his cheering teammates and audience. The scoreboard shows the score increasing.  The video then transitions to a view of the FS1 PBA logo. Next the same bowler is bowling the ball with his teammates watching in the background. After the ball barely makes the pins fall the bowler faces the camera and is surrounded by teammates giving him high fives. The shot is quickly followed by a close-up of his face with the scoreboard behind. In the final shot a teammate is seen about to bowl the ball. Text appearing on the screen includes: "Semifinals - Race to 2", indicating the match's format; the team names "L.A. X" and "Kingpins" with their scores, as well as statistics related to the bowler's ball speed and trajectory. In the background is a crowd of spectators cheering and showing their support for their team.

A scoreboard in the corner indicates the current frame, the race to two points, and scores. Several spectators are visible in the background, some wearing holiday-themed attire. An animated graphic to the right of the screen displays the ball's path, noting its speed at 18.2 MPH and its rotation at 547 RPM. The graphic also tracks the break point and position at arrows. Belmonte raises his arm in celebration and is congratulated by his teammates. The screen then transitions to a close-up shot of another teammate, B.J. Moore, in a blue and black jersey. On the screen, B.J. Moore’s information shows “4 Strikes, 0 Spares, 0 Opens” and is labeled “2019 PBA League”. The spectators are visible in the background again.
